spec.description: Production cAdvisor dashboard for Docker Compose containers. Monitors CPU, memory, networking, filesystem IO, process counts, CPU throttling and OOM events.

spec.title: Running Containers
spec.description: Number of containers currently visible to cAdvisor.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Total CPU utilization relative to configured CPU quota when limits exist.

spec.title: Memory Usage
spec.description: Container working-set memory utilization relative to configured limits.

spec.title: Memory Working Set
spec.description: Current working-set memory across selected containers.

spec.title: Memory Usage vs Limit
spec.description: Container memory consumption compared with configured memory limits.

spec.title: Network Throughput by Container
spec.description: Network receive/transmit throughput grouped by container.

spec.title: CPU Throttling
spec.description: Percentage of CPU scheduling periods that were throttled.

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{name=~"$container", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{name=~"$container", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)

spec.title: OOM Events
spec.description: Out-of-memory events during the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: cAdvisor - Container Infrastructure
